work.author: PIO PP. IX.
work.description: Protesta fatta in Gaeta contro il decreto della sedicente Assemblea costituente romana, 14 febbraio 1849: the pope’s own first-person protest to the diplomatic corps at Gaeta, printed under the heading “Prorrsta fatta in Gaeta li 14 Febbrajo 1849 da Sua Santita PIO PP. IX.” (LF10649–10650), which carries the issuer attribution; complete printed witness LF10649–10710; 1 furniture lines omitted. The following Nota of cardinal Antonelli (LF10714 ff.) is a separate non-papal instrument. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
